task.title: Wire brand variables and establish a real-service smoke-test chain
task.input: The existing Next home page, RUM and model list; the core variables in section 11; the locally reviewed specification branch
task.output: The single visual-base variable source; runnable-smoke; the first implementation PR containing the complete local specification; the CI execution chain
task.accept: 1) Build and start the real standalone service, then click the product entry in the home-page header; computed style must read the black/white and accent colors, 2px borders and 0 border radius from section 11, and a real GET /api/models must return the published source. 2) Actual WebVitals must produce POST /api/rum; verify its 204 response and redacted logs, and run the real-browser smoke test in CI; with reduced motion, the home page must retain a still frame and an explicit play entry (E-22). 3) Bring the locally reviewed documents into this task's PR as its baseline; subsequent tasks must branch from the main branch after this PR lands, without losing the documents.
